description: Given a patient’s symptoms and/or goals (free text or a list — e.g. "fatigue, low libido, want to lose weight"), suggests the most relevant longevity treatment pathways, each with first-line and adjunct medications, a suggested workup, and key things to avoid. Use to triage an intake. PREMIUM tier.

goals.description: Optional explicit list of goals/symptoms. Combined with `symptoms` if both given.

symptoms.description: Patient symptoms and/or goals as free text (e.g. "tired, low sex drive, brain fog").

name: screen_patient_intake
title: Screen Patient Intake → Suggested Pathways
